description: Compare the cost of a DPX settlement against major alternatives — use this when a user asks 'is DPX cheaper than SWIFT?' or 'how much would I save vs Stripe?' or when building a business case for switching payment rails. Returns the DPX all-in fee vs Stripe, Wise, JPMorgan Coin, SWIFT, PayPal, Western Union, and bank wire — with dollar savings and cheaper/not cheaper flag for each. World Bank Q1 2025: global average international transfer cost 6.49%, banks specifically 13.64%.
name: fees.compare
